{{Quote|Order the bay evacuated. I will face him there. Alone.|Saes speaking of his Master, Relin Druur|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
'''Saes Rrogon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] serving the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]] during the onset of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].

Born on [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], Rrogon was the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]]. But the Kaleesh was [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|twisted]] by [[Lignan crystal]]s during an assignment and he fled to the Sith Empire.

In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], as the Great Hyperspace War began, Rrogon was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']]. He and his crew were given a special assignment by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]: collecting Lignan crystals from the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]] for the crucial [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|battle]] of [[Kirrek]]. It was then that Relin Druur and his new Padawan, [[Drev Hassin]], attacked the ''Harbinger'', intending to stop Saes from bringing the ore from leaving the system. Saes [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|dueled]] his former master, seeking to end the score between them once and for all. He succeeded in wounding Druur, but had failed to stop him damaging the Harbinger's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

Druur's actions caused the ''Harbinger'' to accidentally [[Time travel/Legends|jump]] [[41 ABY|over five thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the [[Time/Legends|future]]. With the Lignan ore, Saes used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to keep his ship together until it was out of the warp. Upon learning of what had happened, Saes intended to return his cargo to Sith space, unsure of what had happened to the Empire. [[Mission to the frozen moon|Facing off]] against Druur for the last time, he [[Death/Legends|died]] at the hands of his former Master, who was angered by the death of Drev Hassin.

==Biography==
===As a Padawan===
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]], Saes Rrogon was originally [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticed]] to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]]. While on a mission together, however, they discovered [[Lignan crystal]]s, an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] strong with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. It may have been that Saes was corrupted by the Lignan, resulting in his leaving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to join [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

===As a Sith Lord===
====Harbinger====
In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], during the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] known as the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Rrogon was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in Sadow's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and commanded the Sith [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']]. He was given the mission of extracting Lignan crystals from the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]]. These crystals were vital for Sadow's [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|invasion plan]] on [[Kirrek]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

====Time travel====
Saes and his crew aboard the ''Harbinger'' had [[Time travel/Legends|traveled]] more than five thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in [[Time/Legends|time]] because of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] half destroyed by Relin Druur. Rrogon's ship contained Lignan. He had the ore to bring back to Naga Sadow to help win the Battle of Kirrek. Rrogon [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] his former Master aboard the ''Harbinger'' and [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Mission to the frozen moon|battle]] after Druur used his own anger at his life's failures to kill his former apprentice using Rrogon's own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], [[Shiak|stabbing]] him in the chest. Druur subsequently crashed the ''Harbinger'' on a [[frozen moon]], destroying both the ship and the Lignan and dying as soon as the ship collided with the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] surface.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I have missed your company from time to time."<br />"You have chosen a lonely path, Saes. It is never too late to turn away."<br />"''You'' have chosen the lonely path. The Jedi teach denial of self. That is their weakness. No sentient can long abide that. The Sith embrace the self, and therein lies their strength."<br />"You understand so little. The Jedi teach the interdependence of life. The understanding that all is connected."<br />"A lie. You tried to steal what is best in me, to make me as empty as you.|Saes argues the difference between the Jedi and Sith philosophies with Relin Druur|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Saes Rrogon was a tall male Kaleesh Sith Lord with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], [[Blood/Legends|blood]]-colored reddish-brown skin. Rrogon had scaly skin with tiny [[Horn/Legends|horns]] sprouting from the side of his jaw, and his long hair, tied into a rope with bone circlets, hung to his waist. He often made threats to those who chose to disobey him. He also incorperated Kaleesh views into his combat style and position as a Sith and Captain. Seas often used a flexible, stark-white facemask that he could shape into the likenesses of animals from his homeworld of Kaleesh.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

The Kaleesh [[darksider]], however, displayed great arrogance in his abilities. This caused him to underestimate his former Jedi Master Relin Druur, who using the dark side, Force-choked Saes and impaled him with his own lightsaber, killing him.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Your skill with a lightsaber remains wanting. You rely on strength over technique.''"<br />"''It is well, then, that I've learned other methods.'' [blasts Druur with Force lightning] ''More than you know, even.|Relin Druur and Saes Rrogon, during their first duel on the ''Harbinger''|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Saes had exceptional power and he was known to have had the ability to conjure [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. He displayed the skill of confrontation his Relin, he demonstrated [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force Choke]]. His most impressive use of the Force, was when he drew upon the power of the Lignan ore to pull the Harbinger out of hyperspace.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

Saes also had some knowledge of lightsaber combat, which was great enough to sever his old Master's arm off and nearly kill him.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
